```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(BPCells)
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(here)
library(viridis)
```

# setup
```{r params}
module = "beige_vs_white"
method_name = "fastmnn"
dataname = paste0("bvw_",method_name)
load_data = T #loading data
subset_data = F

rmd_filename = "bvw_fastmnn_monocle_plots_10x"
i_am(file.path("analysis", module, paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))
odir = here("output", module, dataname) 
```

```{r setup}
set.seed(8)
fig_dir = here("analysis", module, "figures", rmd_filename)
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(fig_dir, "/"),
                      dev = c("png","pdf"))

if (!dir.exists(odir)) dir.create(odir, recursive = TRUE)
```


```{r themes}
theme_hp = theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.background = element_blank())
theme_set(theme_hp)
pal_white = c("#B3B3B3","#85C2EA","#1F78B4")
names(pal_white) = c("day0","day1","day3")
prog_cols = c("#DA1819","#691A93","#EBB400" , "#434D51","#00AED1","#3AAD00","#FF7F00")
prog_levels = c("p5","p4","p6","p3","p0","p1","p2")
names(prog_cols) = paste0("p", 0:(length(prog_levels)-1))
clusters = MetBrewer::met.brewer("Redon", 12)
names(clusters) = 0:11
spectral = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = 'Spectral'))
```

## load pseudotime from subsets

write with copilot:
input file pattern : 

```{r}
dir_list = grep("/subset_", list.dirs(odir), value=T) # 12 subsets with random numbers
pscond_list = c("white", "beige")

# Setup lists to populate
white_list = list()
beige_list = list()

for (subset_dir in dir_list){
    subset_no = gsub(".*/subset_", "", subset_dir)
    
    # Read white data
    white_data = read.delim(file.path(subset_dir, "white_monocle_pseudotime.tsv"))
    white_data = white_data %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
        mutate(subset_no = subset_no) %>%
        select(cell_id, pscondition, subset_no, raw_pseudotime, monocle_pseudotime)
    white_list[[subset_no]] = white_data
    
    # Read beige data
    beige_data = read.delim(file.path(subset_dir, "beige_monocle_pseudotime.tsv"))
    beige_data = beige_data %>%
        tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id") %>%
        mutate(subset_no = subset_no) %>%
        select(cell_id, pscondition, subset_no, raw_pseudotime, monocle_pseudotime)
    beige_list[[subset_no]] = beige_data
}

# Combine all subsets into final tibbles
white_meta = bind_rows(white_list)
beige_meta = bind_rows(beige_list)
```


```{r}
head(white_meta)
mc_meta = rbind(white_meta, beige_meta)
nrow(mc_meta)
head(mc_meta)
```

## load seurat 
```{r}
if (subset_data){
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir, "10%_complete_analysis.rds"))
  Idents(sbs) = "seurat_clusters"
} else {
  sbs = readRDS(here(odir,"complete_analysis.rds"))
  DefaultAssay(sbs) = "RNA"
}
sbs
```

```{r}
merge_mc= merge(mc_meta, sbs@meta.data, by.x="cell_id",by.y="row.names", all.x=T)
head(merge_mc)
write.table(merge_mc, here(odir, "subset_summary_monocle_pseudotime.tsv"), row.names=F, sep="\t", quote=F)
```


# Violin plot progenitor colours

```{r}
ggplot(merge_mc, 
       aes(x=monocle_pseudotime, y=time.progen_clusters, fill=time.progen_clusters)) + 
    geom_violin(scale="width") + geom_beeswarm(stat='summary', fun="mean", aes(group=subset_no), cex = 1.5)+
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(pal_white, prog_cols)) +  
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + scale_y_discrete(limits = c("day3","day1", rev(prog_levels))) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL) + 
    facet_grid(pscondition~.)

```


```{r}
mean_per_progen_cluster = group_by(merge_mc, subset_no, time.progen_clusters, pscondition) %>% 
    summarise(mean_pseudotime= mean(monocle_pseudotime))
head(mean_per_progen_cluster)

ggplot(mean_per_progen_cluster, aes(y=time.progen_clusters, fill=time.progen_clusters))+
       geom_boxplot( aes(x=mean_pseudotime))+
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(pal_white, prog_cols)) +  
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + scale_y_discrete(limits = c("day3","day1", rev(prog_levels))) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL) +
    facet_grid(pscondition~.)

ggplot(mean_per_progen_cluster, aes(y=time.progen_clusters, fill=time.progen_clusters, x=mean_pseudotime))+
       geom_violin(scale="width", alpha=0.75)+ geom_boxplot(fill="transparent", width=0.4,colour="black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(pal_white, prog_cols)) +  
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + scale_y_discrete(limits = c("day3","day1", rev(prog_levels))) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL) +
    facet_grid(pscondition~.)
```


## Ideal plot
1. load full pseudotime
2. plot means per progen.cluster derived from downsampling 

```{r}
meta= read.delim(here(odir, "monocle_pseudotime.tsv"))
meta$time.progen_clusters = factor(meta$time.progen_clusters )
meta$initial_clusters = factor(meta$initial_clusters, levels = c(0:11))
meta$cond.time = factor(meta$cond.time, levels=c("white.day3","white.day1","asc.day0","beige.day1","beige.day3"))
table(meta$time.progen_clusters)
table(meta$cond.time)
```


```{r}
ggplot(meta, 
       aes(x=monocle_pseudotime, y=time.progen_clusters, fill=time.progen_clusters)) + 
    geom_violin(scale="width") + 
    geom_boxplot(data=mean_per_progen_cluster, aes(x=mean_pseudotime), fill="transparent")+
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(pal_white, prog_cols)) +  
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + scale_y_discrete(limits = c("day3","day1", rev(prog_levels))) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL) + 
    facet_grid(pscondition~.)
```

```{r}
ggplot(mean_per_progen_cluster, 
       aes(y=time.progen_clusters, fill=time.progen_clusters, x=mean_pseudotime))+
    geom_violin(data=meta, aes(x=monocle_pseudotime),
                  fill="grey50",scale="width") +
       geom_violin(scale="width", alpha=0.75, width=0.5)+ geom_boxplot(fill="transparent", width=0.4,colour="black") +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(pal_white, prog_cols)) +  
    coord_cartesian(expand=F, x=c(0,0.99)) + 
    scale_y_discrete(limits = c("day3","day1", rev(prog_levels))) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL)+ 
    facet_grid(pscondition~.)

ggplot(mean_per_progen_cluster, aes(y=time.progen_clusters, fill=time.progen_clusters, x=mean_pseudotime))+
    geom_violin(data=filter(meta, condition %in% c("asc","white")), aes(x=monocle_pseudotime),
                  fill="grey50",scale="width") + 
    geom_boxplot( colour="black", alpha=0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values=c(pal_white, prog_cols)) +  
    coord_cartesian(expand=F) + scale_y_discrete(limits = c("day3","day1", rev(prog_levels))) +
    labs(x="Monocle pseudotime", title=NULL, fill = "Average pseudotime") + 
    facet_grid(pscondition~.)
```
